title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `guardian`
description: mix.lock declares a locked package name in mix.lock within one edit of `guardian`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The lockfile records what Mix will fetch, so a name that only looks like the intended package is installed without any earlier review step. The name this rule expects is `guardian`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.lock (hex).
risk: The lockfile records what Mix will fetch, so a name that only looks like the intended package is installed without any earlier review step. The name this rule expects is `guardian`.
